    • setStateBoundaries

      public static void setStateBoundaries(double stepSize, double minState, double maxState)
      Initializes the state space boundaries. Note that stepSize must be one if DiscreteDistributionInt are used.
      Parameters:
      stepSize - the discretization step used to encode the state space
      minState - the minimum value used to encode a state
      maxState - the maximum value used to encode a state
